verdict.rationale: LM Studio is designed for local self-hosting: it runs entirely on-device, can serve models over the network via an OpenAI-compatible REST API, and offers a headless mode (llmster) plus CLI server start/stop for server/CI use (lm-studio-docs-5, lm-studio-docs-8, lm-studio-docs-9, lm-studio-docs-12). However, it is closed-source with a restrictive license disallowing work use, and users report confusion configuring network access and no proper Linux support, which undercuts the 'openness' expectation of self-hosting for an AI-native audience (lm-studio-comm-4, lm-studio-comm-8, lm-studio-comm-15, lm-studio-comm-16, lm-studio-comm-2).
